title: Comparisons between relative limit cones
statement:
Use small quasicategories, coherent functor categories, mapping spaces, homotopy fibres and equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], inner fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and relative limit diagrams and joins of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Let $q:D\to B$ be an inner fibration of small quasicategories, let $K$ be a small simplicial set, and let $\lambda,\mu:K^{\triangleleft}\to D$ be $q$-limit diagrams with equal boundaries and equal images in $B$. The homotopy fibre of the mapping-space map
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K^{\triangleleft},D)}(\lambda,\mu)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,D)}(\lambda|_K,\mu|_K)\mathop{\times}^{h}_{\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,B)}(q\lambda|_K,q\mu|_K)}\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K^{\triangleleft},B)}(q\lambda,q\mu)$$
over the pair of identities is contractible. Every coherent comparison in this fibre has an equivalence on cone vertices. In particular, a specified comparison between two relative product cones with identical boundary and base is an equivalence on their apices. This includes an empty boundary.

source.place: Higher Algebra (2017), Theorem 2.3.3.23(1), printed pp. 266-268; Converse condition (ii): comparison of the two relative product cones on the local unary projections. Agent expansion of the proof; read online 2026-10-17, WANTED archive in report.md. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical result.
